import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 杀神榜
 * 指令：/杀神榜
 *
 * 展示煞气 ≥ 30 的玩家列表
 */

import { MSG_PVP } from '@src/constants/messages';
import App from '@src/response-apps/killGodList/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '杀神榜', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const { list, shaQiInfo, robberyRemaining, killGodThreshold, robberyDailyMax, streakText, rankingRuleText, canClaimTitle } = result.data;

  if (list.length === 0) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(MSG_PVP.KILL_GOD_EMPTY);
    md.addNewline();

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '杀神榜',
        header: [
          { label: '悬赏榜', command: '/悬赏榜' },
          { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' }
        ],
        footer: [
          { label: '记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
          { label: '悬赏', command: '/悬赏' },
          { label: '仇人', command: '/仇人' },
          { label: '煞气', command: '/煞气' },
          { label: '金盆', command: '/消耗 金盆 1' }
        ],
        content: md
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (shaQiInfo) {
    md.addText(`当前煞气：${shaQiInfo.shaQi} | 打劫剩余：${robberyRemaining}/${robberyDailyMax}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`上榜条件：煞气≥${killGodThreshold}`);
    md.addNewline();

    if (streakText) {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(streakText));
    }

    md.addNewline();
  }

  for (const entry of list) {
    md.addText(`【${entry.rank}】${entry.name}  煞气 ${entry.shaQi}`);
    md.addNewline();
  }

  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`共 ${list.length} 人在榜`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(rankingRuleText);
  md.addNewline();

  if (canClaimTitle) {
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('🏆 你当前是杀神榜榜一，可领取「杀神」称号');
    md.addNewline();
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '杀神榜',
      header: [
        { label: '悬赏榜', command: '/悬赏榜' },
        { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' }
      ],
      footer: [
        { label: '记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
        { label: '悬赏', command: '/悬赏' },
        { label: '仇人', command: '/仇人' },
        { label: '煞气', command: '/煞气' },
        { label: '金盆', command: '/消耗 金盆 1' },
        ...(canClaimTitle ? [{ label: '称号', command: '/领取杀神称号' }] : [])
      ],
      content: md
    })
  );
});
